title: Investigating Language and Retrieval Bias in Multilingual Previously Fact-Checked Claim Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (using Macro F1, True Negative Rate, and False Negative Rate) on fact-checked claim detection across 20 different languages and multiple prompting strategies to identify disparities between high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource languages.

Analyzing the frequency of retrieved fact-checked claims across different queries using retrieval metrics (Success@K, MAP, MRR) and topic modeling to detect the systematic over-representation of specific popular, generic, or structurally noisy claims regardless of their actual relevance.
